subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: After the three code defects are fixed, should OpenClaw accept `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0`, its `node-pty` install script, and the full base64 sandbox envelope on `wxc-exec` argv for this prerelease Windows plugin?
rationale: The remaining choice defines the supported sandbox and supply-chain trust boundary; source correctness review cannot authorize it on behalf of repository admins or secops.

options.title: Accept as prerelease
options.body: Approve the exact repaired head, explicitly document the preview dependency and argv exposure, and require fresh native Windows isolation proof.

options.title: Wait for upstream transport
options.body: Pause the PR until MXC provides a non-argv configuration transport, then reassess the native dependency graph.

recommendation.title: Accept as prerelease
recommendation.body: Approve the exact repaired head, explicitly document the preview dependency and argv exposure, and require fresh native Windows isolation proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently reviewing the exact sandbox and SDK security boundary, with secops approval additionally required by CODEOWNERS and dependency guard.
